_comment: The ONE place that names the fonts. make-fonts.py reads this, writes assets/fonts/*.ttf and ui/fonts.slint (the Fonts global the whole design system uses). To change a font: change `package` (an @fontsource-variable package) and `family`, then run the script. serif = titles, headings, card titles, the logo and button labels (Playfair Display under the name Kasboek Display, see make-fonts.py); sans and num = everything else.
